notes.content:

Join them as they chronicle the entire Ace Attorney series, starting from the beginning with Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney and the very first “Objection!”.

notes.title: Ace Attorney Investigations Collection is available now!
notes.content:
Ace Attorney Investigations Collection is available now! Join prodigious prosecutor Miles Edgeworth as he pursues the truth at any cost in two beautifully remastered games, complete with redesigned chibi character sprites, an array of special content and features, and the Western debut of Ace Attorney Investigations 2: Prosecutor's Gambit. 

A demo is also available to download on Steam. Step out of the courtroom to investigate crime scenes and deduce facts in the first half of the first case of each game in the collection.

notes.title: Miles Edgeworth has returned!
notes.content:
EUREKA! Miles Edgeworth moves beyond the courtroom and straight to the crime scene in Ace Attorney Investigations Collection! This remastered collection of both spin-off titles includes Investigations 2's Western debut, revamped graphics, new languages, bonus features, and more!
